question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Q2 FY27 call (Aug 2026), CFO Kress said Q4 FY27 gross margin would 'trough' at 71-72% because memory prices spiked, after 75.0% in Q2 and a 74.0% Q3 guide. She expects 72-73% in FY2028 once price increases take effect in Q1. NVIDIA usually guides close to what it pre-signals, so the formal Q4 guide in the Nov 2026 release will most likely sit inside 71-72%, probably near 71.5%. Downside risk: memory 'headed even higher' could push the guide to the 70s. Upside: earlier price increases or easing memory costs. No human prediction market found (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, bookmakers checked by search).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: Q2 GM 75.0%, Q3 guide 74.0%, and a pre-signaled Q4 FY27 trough of 71-72% from the Aug 26 call. They differ only on tail width and escape mass (Run 3 is narrower with no escapes; Runs 1-2 are wider with small escapes). No web access on this run. The GAAP vs non-GAAP basis of the 71-72% signal could not be confirmed, but the bases differ by only about 0.1pt, so it doesn't matter. I took the wider tails because NVIDIA has deviated from pre-signals before (Blackwell transition) and memory costs are still rising. Median 71.5 with a slight downside tilt in the low tail; small escape masses for a further memory shock or ramp charges (low side) and earlier pricing relief (high side). I agree with and carry forward Runs 1-2's reference class and dispersion.
